args.title: Fix the cause of issue 4429 in src/api/reports.ts
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The duplication process uses the truncate function to append ' (copy)' to the report name, but does not account for the name being truncated at the maximum length, resulting in a direct copy of the existing name with '...' instead of '(copy)'.
